paper.title: RepairAgent: An Autonomous, LLM-Based Agent for Program Repair

problem_tree.node: Root: Does an autonomous LLM-based agent effectively repair real Java bugs?
problem_tree.description: Evaluate RepairAgent as an autonomous program-repair agent on real Java bugs and compare it with recent LLM-based repair baselines.

children.node: RQ1: How effective is RepairAgent on Defects4J compared with LLM-based repair baselines?

children.task: Reconstruct Defects4J aggregate correct-fix counts from released artifact inputs.
children.protocol_or_setup: Use released aggregate inputs and baseline lists; do not treat bounded replay as the full aggregate.
children.conclusion: Adopted as the main FIRE-Bench-SE target. RepairAgent has 164 unique correct Defects4J fixes out of 835 bugs; ChatRepair has 162, SelfAPR has 109 unique fixes, ITER has 57, and RepairAgent-only fixes are 39.

children.node: RQ2: Does RepairAgent remain competitive across Defects4J project subsets?

children.task: Reconstruct legacy-project and additional-project split counts.
children.protocol_or_setup: Use the split available in the artifact and avoid renaming it into paper-only labels when the visible package does not support that mapping.
children.conclusion: Adopted as a supporting target. RepairAgent has 90 legacy-project fixes and 74 additional-project fixes; comparable baseline split counts are reconstructable from the visible artifact.

children.node: RQ3: What evidence supports the correctness labels?

children.task: Inspect manual-review notes for developer-match and semantic-equivalence provenance.
children.protocol_or_setup: Use visible manual-review notes only as provenance evidence; do not infer complete correctness provenance for all fixes.
children.conclusion: Partially adopted. The visible notes contain 112 labeled entries, including 71 identical, 37 semantically equivalent, and 4 good-enough labels, but they do not reconstruct full provenance for all 164 correct fixes.

children.node: RQ4: Does RepairAgent generalize to GitBug-Java?

children.protocol_or_setup: Check whether visible GitBug-Java execution results exist before using the claim.
children.conclusion: Excluded from the hidden answer. The visible task package contains a GitBug-Java sample list but not enough execution results to reconstruct the claim.

children.node: RQ5: Which RepairAgent components matter in ablation?

children.task: Reconstruct ablation counts for component removals.
children.protocol_or_setup: Require ablation logs or result files before including this claim in the hidden answer.
children.conclusion: Excluded from the hidden answer. The visible artifact lacks enough ablation logs or result files to reconstruct the counts.

children.node: RQ6: Can stored patches be replayed on a bounded sample?

children.task: Run bounded Defects4J replay on a small sample.
children.protocol_or_setup: Use bounded replay only to check execution path and patch application behavior.
children.conclusion: Smoke-only. Bounded replay is useful executable evidence but must not be treated as the full Defects4J aggregate result.
